newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanjin Shipping to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Hanjin Shipping to buy back shares.

text.p: South Korea's Hanjin Shipping Co said on Wednesday it would buy back 100,000 of its own common shares in the open market to boost its share price.
The buyback, representing 0.85 percent of its share capital, will be made between November 11 and February 10 through Hanjin Investment and Securities Co, a company statement said.
Hanjin Shipping, a unit of Hanjin Group, currently holds 240,000 of its own shares, or 2.04 percent of the share capital, the statement said.
Buying orders will be placed at the stock's previous closing price, it said.
Hanjin Shipping shares closed at 20,100 won on Wednesday, up 1,000 won on the day.
